issues.detail: The Hebrew 'אַתָּה גוֹזִי' means 'you are the one who drew me out' (from the womb), i.e., 'you are my deliverer/one who brought me forth'. The Chinese renders it as '你便是我的神' ('you are my God'), which changes the meaning: the Hebrew does not say 'my God' here but 'the one who drew me out'.
